issues.detail: The Greek 'το πνευμα το εκ του θεου' (the spirit from God) is translated as 'Thánh Linh' (Holy Spirit). While often associated, 'Thánh Linh' carries a specific theological designation of the Third Person of the Trinity, whereas the Greek text simply specifies 'the spirit from God' in contrast to 'the spirit of the world'.
